text: The LSOA Kingston upon Hull 015A has a moderate GeoSensitivity of **-1.40**, ranking 20th of 168, indicating comparative geographic influence. Its spatial pattern is not significant, so no local clustering of GeoSensitivity is detected. The latitude effect is 0.116 and longitude effect is -0.046, distinct from GeoSensitivity. Evaluation shows stable and consistent Geo branch explanations with no causal claims supported.
